# [M] Luckyos incident: The law of the random number generated by Lucky's rock-paper-scissors game was cracked by hackers, and the attacker won the prize

## Summary
Severity: Medium
Target: Luckyos
Loss: -
Attack method: Random number attack
Published: 2018-08-27
Source: https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/DnhtzdWeRziK030FSolDbA
Type: slowmist-incident

## Details
The law of the random number generated by Lucky's rock-paper-scissors game was cracked by hackers, and the attacker won the prize by continuing to use rock at the specified time, which has a 38% chance of winning.
